notes.text: Pass project-specific parameters to a managed dev server generically; WinPath's E2E reset configuration is the motivating example.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: WinPath uses environment variables such as E2E_RESET_DB_CONFIRM, PLAYWRIGHT_E2E_RESET_SECRET, PLAYWRIGHT_E2E_DB_LAB, and GOOGLE_CALENDAR_E2E_FIXTURES. Model this primarily as typed environment overrides and profiles, not shell text appended to a command.

notes.author: user
notes.text: Extend environment configuration with directories and make appropriate profile operations available to agents through MCP.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Implemented validated literal per-project environment overrides and named profiles. Existing values migrate into default; dashboard users can create, copy, edit, select, delete, and save-and-restart profiles, while MCP exposes list, save, select, and delete operations. Selection persists across Node.js and Django worktree switches. PORT and NODE_ENV remain reserved, and audits record names without values. Secret references, environment files, working directories, PATH prefixes, required directories, scoped MCP capabilities, and CLI support remain open.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Corrected the outdated claim that only PORT is supported. The 2026-08-31 note records working literals and named profiles. Remaining enhancements should save time on a real workflow and have a generic fixture; this is not a mandate to build every profile option at once.

notes.author: human:pioootrek
notes.text: Owner supplied Secret Runtime v2 documentation and requested inclusion in Switcher. Original files are preserved in NOTE-20260905-secret-runtime-proposal; docs/environment-runtime-plan.md defines the integration direction. Reuse existing profiles and workers for scoped secret delivery; the original PostgreSQL/Rust stack, standalone vault, provider sync, rotation, and all-now milestone priorities are not automatically adopted.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: 2026-09-27 reconciliation: literal runtime/test profiles and their existing MCP operations are delivered. No evidence that secret references, environment-file references or monorepo-relative working directories have shipped. Keep these as independent, need-driven slices; runtime capability scopes remain in FEAT-20260829-scoped-mcp-agent-tokens. No new implementation selected by this documentation pass.

problem: Validated literal profiles and MCP profile operations exist. Remaining gaps include monorepo working directories, referenced secrets/environment files, required directories, and CLI access; these should be introduced as independently useful slices.

risk.rollback: Revert only the added profile capability and preserve existing literal profiles and selected configuration. Do not silently launch with a different environment when a new path or secret reference cannot be resolved.

scope: Keep existing literal profiles. Select the next slice from an observed owner workflow and reproduce it with a portable fixture: relative working directory, named secret reference, environment-file reference, required directory, or CLI operation.

Resolve worktree-relative paths against exact Git discovery and reject traversal/symlink escape. Host paths belong in explicit local configuration, never framework-specific branches or portable skills.
Keep secret resolution controller-side and return only names/source metadata. Reserve runtime loader variables and PORT/NODE_ENV, and preserve controlled restart for active profile changes.
Preserve the previously requested capability boundaries when scoped tokens are implemented. Do not imply that today's shared bearer/session model already supports scopes.
PATH prefixes and the full remaining profile surface are later slices unless a concrete supported command requires them. Production mode is a separate item.

Use docs/environment-runtime-plan.md for the secret-reference slice: worker-side resolution for an authorized project/commit/preset/profile, explicit grant/source-trust policy, safe version attribution, and headless-worker behavior. Keep memory/forum access separate from credential-use permission.
source: Product discussion and WinPath inspection on 2026-08-29
title: Extend existing profiles only for concrete reusable launch needs
validation: For the selected enhancement, reproduce the owner workflow with a portable fixture outside the owner's repositories. Preserve existing Node.js and Django literal-profile behavior and controller-owned PORT/NODE_ENV.

For path-related slices, verify allowed relative working directories/files/directories and reject traversal, symlink escape, missing inputs, and invalid types before spawn. Directory creation must be idempotent and never imply deletion.
For a secret-reference slice, verify missing references fail before spawn and values never enter SQLite, API/MCP responses, audit records, or diagnostic output.
Verify active-profile changes require the existing controlled restart, mutations remain owner-authorized, and command execution remains shell-free.

When scoped tokens are introduced, verify profiles:select and config:write separately in their owning token item. Record completed and remaining profile slices explicitly instead of treating deferred scopes or PATH support as already implemented.

For scoped runtime secrets, verify unavailable references, wrong project/profile, untrusted code, grant expiry/revocation, worker restart, setup-step exposure, and safe version metadata. Document that injected code can read secrets and that grant revocation is not provider credential revocation.
value: Projects can express development, E2E, fixture, and diagnostic modes without project-specific code in Worktree Switcher or unsafe free-form command execution.
